issues.proposition: Retain the legal right to request euthanasia subject to the law's conditions.
issues.authoredCrossReference: Retaining the legal right differs from changing safeguards, strengthening palliative care, unrestricted assisted death or a general claim about dignified death.

cells.rationale: Propone derogar la ley de eutanasia y aprobar una ley de cuidados paliativos.
cells.authoredAnalysis: Explicit repeal, not inference from palliative-care support. Abortion law in same sentence is not included in the question.

citations.quote:
la deroga             -
      ción de las leyes de eutanasia y del aborto.

cells.rationale: Propone respetar la autonomía al final de la vida conforme a la ley de eutanasia, junto con cuidados paliativos.
cells.authoredAnalysis: Full elder-care measure10 explicitly coheres with the euthanasia law; not unrestricted assistance.

citations.quote:
en coherencia con lo establecido en la Ley de Regulación de
la Eutanasia.

cells.rationale: Propone revisar la ley de eutanasia teniendo en cuenta al Comité de Bioética, sin concretar qué derechos cambiaría.
cells.authoredAnalysis: Review is not repeal or a clear retained-right commitment; no numeric stance inferred.

citations.quote:
revisaremos
     la Ley de Eutanasia

cells.rationale: Propone que jueces y magistrados elijan a los doce miembros de procedencia judicial.

los jueces y
     magistrados los que elijan a los 12 vocales de procedencia judicial.

cells.rationale: Propone mantener la elección parlamentaria de los miembros de procedencia judicial.

citations.quote:
En cuanto a
los vocales del CGPJ de procedencia judicial, mantenemos el modelo de elección parlamentaria.

issues.proposition: Prohibit hunting animals throughout Spain.
issues.authoredCrossReference: General hunting legality is distinct from lead-shot restrictions, wolf protection, poaching penalties and licence harmonisation.

cells.rationale: Propone conseguir la prohibición de la caza.
cells.authoredAnalysis: Section 1.1.8.1 treats a general hunting ban as the objective and animal-as-hunting-tool restrictions as interim measures. Pages 14-16 read in full; attributed environmental allegations are not neutral premises.

citations.quote: mientras se consigue la prohibición de la caza

cells.rationale: Defiende la caza y propone una licencia única válida en todo el territorio nacional.
cells.authoredAnalysis: Measures 323/323.2 explicitly defend lawful hunting and implement nationwide licences. This directly retains the activity, rather than inferring opposition from absence of a ban; wolf-management clauses are separate.

issues.proposition: Reduce companion-animal veterinary-service VAT to at most 10 percent.
issues.authoredCrossReference: Veterinary-service VAT reduction differs from free veterinary care and changing all healthcare-product taxes. Keep the distinct proposed 10% and 4% rates visible.

cells.rationale: Propone reducir al 10% el IVA de los servicios veterinarios.
cells.authoredAnalysis: Measure 2 separately recognises clinics as health centres and specifies 10% VAT. No free-care inference; the broader veterinary service scope includes companion animals.

citations.quote:
reducción del IVA de los
servicios veterinarios al 10%.

cells.rationale: Propone reducir al 4% el IVA de los servicios veterinarios, por debajo del 10% planteado.
cells.authoredAnalysis: Section 1.7 expressly chooses 4% rather than 10% and discusses companion-animal services. A lower rate meets the proposition without falsely calling both programmes identical.

citations.quote: al tipo superreducido del 4%

issues.proposition: Allow independent repair shops to repair products without exclusive manufacturer-service requirements.
issues.authoredCrossReference: Choice of independent repairer differs from mere spare-part availability, free repair, guarantee duration and weakened safety rules. Each is a separate consumer decision.

cells.rationale: Propone permitir acudir a cualquier taller de reparación, sin obligar a usar el servicio oficial del fabricante.
cells.authoredAnalysis: Section 2.5 directly links any-repair-shop choice to absence of mandatory official manufacturer service. Parts and warranty reforms are separate supporting access measures.

citations.quote: usuarios puedan acudir a cualquier tienda de reparación

cells.rationale: Propone garantizar por ley piezas, licencias y manuales para reparadores independientes.
cells.authoredAnalysis: Measure 3.3 explicitly makes legal repair access available to independent repairers as well as consumers/community groups. This supports the repair-choice decision, independently of a parts-only pledge.

citations.quote:
licencias
        y manuales de reparación para las personas consumidoras, reparadoras independientes

issues.proposition: Implement deposit-refund return systems for used beverage containers.
issues.authoredCrossReference: A deposit-refund return mechanism differs from ordinary recycling bins, refill-only packaging and a tax on disposable materials. No deposit amount, collection target or retailer scope invented.

cells.rationale: Propone adelantar a 2025 la implantación de sistemas de depósito, devolución y retorno de envases.
cells.authoredAnalysis: Circular-economy measure 1 gives a firm implementation date, distinct from reused-packaging percentage targets and taxes. Deposit amount and return locations are not stated.

citations.quote: Adelantar la implantación de sistema de devolución, depósito y retorno al año 2025.

cells.rationale: Propone sistemas de retorno de envases, pero esta formulación no precisa por sí sola el depósito que se pagaría al comprar.
cells.authoredAnalysis: Full page advocates return systems and separately describes existing conditional deposit/devolution/return law. The financial deposit mechanism is not repeated as an operative unconditional pledge; do not assume it solely from a broader return objective.
